subject.title: ci: hourly sweeper re-fires dropped pull_request CI runs

question: Should this hourly PR-closing automation be approved only after both App-token paths are explicitly least-privileged and a controlled live recovery has been demonstrated?
rationale: The intended behavior is operationally useful, but the acceptable authority of a scheduled workflow that closes and reopens pull requests is a repository security and operations decision.

options.title: Scope and prove before merge
options.body: Explicitly request only the permissions needed by the sweeper in both token steps, then publish redacted dry-run and controlled live-run evidence.

options.title: Accept installation-wide token authority
options.body: Land the workflow with inherited installation permissions only if maintainers explicitly accept that broader scheduled-automation boundary.

recommendation.title: Scope and prove before merge
recommendation.body: Explicitly request only the permissions needed by the sweeper in both token steps, then publish redacted dry-run and controlled live-run evidence.
